title: The owner's rulings
description: The owner's standing rulings on the use of sources, one file per owner, from which every tool that writes a capture plan copies each entry's ruling (contracts/rulings.md).

note.description: what the file is for, in a sentence or two

all.description: the ruling for every adapter, present and future, unless by_adapter names it

by_adapter.description: rulings for single adapters by id, each overriding all for that adapter; empty when all covers every one
